$comment: INPUTS of the Hermes we build for Android (#648). .github/workflows/hermes-android.yml builds
com.facebook.hermes:hermes-android from exactly this Hermes commit, plus the patches below, with
Hermes's own Android Gradle build (the one Meta publishes to Maven Central with) and this
toolchain, then publishes the Maven files as the assets of `releaseTag` on this repository.
The patch builds it WITHOUT Boost.Context fibers (HERMES_ALLOW_BOOST_CONTEXT=0): see the patch.
What was published is pinned in artifact.json; plugins/withPatchedHermes.js consumes it.
prebuild fails otherwise, so a React Native bump cannot silently ship another Hermes build.
`toolchain` mirrors android/gradle/libs.versions.toml at `commit` (ndkVersion, cmake, buildTools, compileSdk).
Changing anything here needs a new `releaseTag` (published assets are never replaced).
